description: Create a cinematic BRAND FILM as one self-contained HTML file: a manifesto told in few, beautiful words, colour-field or photo panels with slow Ken Burns moves, values that draw themselves, and a logo sting with letter stagger and tracking settle, carried by a synthesized score (pads, bells, long reverb) or synced to a voiceover. Verified frame by frame and exportable to MP4. Use for brand manifestos, origin and mission stories, values and culture films, rebrand reveals, anniversaries, recruitment films, idents and 5-second logo stings, for any company, studio, product or cause, in any style from premium to playful. Accepts creative dials --creativity, --typography, --animation and --motion (low, medium or high; medium by default).
